items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And some of the best things that were done in any of those pieces were Neal's.

ctx.x: And actually, he came up with a lot of ideas and a lot of head things that he put together or helped to put together, where everyone contributed. And some of the best things that were done in any of those pieces were Neal's. But actually, his full arrangements, I think, after The Good Earth and -- I'll name them all -- The Good Earth, Black Orchid and Let It Snow, Let It Snow, and one other, I can't think of what it is, were the only complete things that he brought in.
